title: David Perla interviewed on "The Financial Modeler's Corner" podcast
summary: Vice Chair David Perla is a guest on the "Financial Modeler’s Corner” podcast, where he discusses litigation risk modeling for finance professionals. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Vice Chair[David Perla](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/david-perla/) is a guest on the "Financial Modeler’s Corner” podcast, where he discusses litigation risk modeling for finance professionals.


As the podcast description reads: "From managing long litigation timelines to leveraging Monte Carlo simulations and AI tools, David shares how Burford builds sophisticated models to guide investment decisions and mitigate risk."


Click[here](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/litigation-risk-modeling-for-finance-professionals/id1693354484?i=1000704440338) to listen on Apple Podcasts, and[here](https://open.spotify.com/episode/4YzaZDjbuJCnTL8NXfNAME?si=5cnao4DLTVKHaAq8GF9P_g&nd=1&dlsi=e506eeba4c084cd7) to listen on Spotify.
